text:
sam: Quick mtg note / we keep seeing edge-case PII leakage when requests are rerouted to fallback models (different shard). Need a small policy + implementation pattern before we flip per-tenant inspect on.

elaine: Agreed. Observed issue: reroute copies KV cache prefixes and sometimes stores truncated user snippets in shard-local cache that sampling later exposes.

rohit: Short proposal: when a request is eligible for inspect/payload capture, assign it a capture_state header (metadata|truncated|full). Any reroute that crosses tenant-boundary or shard boundary must downgrade capture_state to metadata or truncated automatically.

sam: I like that. Also: add a de-dup guard for embeddings/attachment ids so that dedupe jobs don't re-link fingerprints across tenants.

elaine: Implementation details: fingerprinting -> HMAC per-tenant salt + salt_id. Additionally, for dedupe we store tenant-scoped index only. Global dedupe returns counts but never fingerprints.

rohit: Envelope sketch (metadata-first):
```json
{"env":"v4","tenant":"t-zzz","capture_state":"truncated","sample_reason":"fallback:routing","fingerprint":"hmac-v1:abc123","fields":["route","latency_ms","resp_hint"]}
```

sre-amy: Ops notes: add a rule in router: if target_shard != origin_shard OR target_tenant != origin_tenant then enforce capture_state <= truncated. Also emit a `capture_downgrade` metric.

sam: Console UX ask: show `capture_state` per event and a small banner when a reroute caused a downgrade (so approvers know they didnt get full payload).

elaine: For dedupe: never export fingerprint values in aggregated logs. Aggregations show counts only and are normalized per-tenant.

policy-bot: POLICY REMINDER: attachments & embeddings are HIGH sensitivity; default to blocked in cross-shard reroutes. Require explicit owner approval + audit entry to capture.

rohit: TTL: downgraded captures TTL=7d, full captures TTL=30d. All entries can be placed on legal_hold via API.

sre-amy: Runbook: if we detect cross-shard fingerprint re-use, auto-quarantine recent captures and alert infra + security.

sam: Action items: rohit -> add router downgrade rule + metric, elaine -> dedupe change to tenant-scoped index, amy -> runbook + alert, i'll update RFC with capture_state enum + console copy.

elaine: Put behind feature flag `inspect_crossshard_safety_v1` and canary on one internal tenant.

rohit: RFC link when ready?

sam: posting RFC in ~3h: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/r/cross-shard-capture-safety-v1
